AbilityDef.label: healing touch
AbilityDef.description: Heals up to 25 points of injury on the target, worst wounds first. Touch range.

AbilityDef.label: cleanse
AbilityDef.description: Removes diseases, wound infections, food poisoning, and toxic buildup from the target. Touch range.

AbilityDef.label: blessing
AbilityDef.description: The target gains +10% consciousness for 1 day.

AbilityDef.label: battle hymn
AbilityDef.description: Allies within 9.9 cells gain +0.40 move speed and +8% melee hit chance for 2 minutes.

AbilityDef.label: inspiring verse
AbilityDef.description: One ally fights inspired for 30 seconds: melee attacks 20% harder and 15% faster, +10% shooting accuracy, and a much steadier mind.

AbilityDef.label: dirge
AbilityDef.description: A song for the dead, sung early. Enemies within 6.9 cells lose their aim rather than their nerve: -15% shooting accuracy, -15% melee hit chance and -10% consciousness for 40 seconds.

AbilityDef.label: song of rest
AbilityDef.description: Allies within 9.9 cells gain +25% rest rate and 50% faster injury healing for 12 hours, and each restores 15 Energy. The singer gains no Energy.

AbilityDef.label: charge
AbilityDef.description:
The caster sprints at five times normal move speed for 5 seconds. Close the line before the line closes you.
In turn-based combat the surge grants +4 AP on cast, offsetting most of its cost.

AbilityDef.label: stand fast
AbilityDef.description: Allies within 6.9 cells take 35% less damage for 40 seconds.

AbilityDef.label: second wind
AbilityDef.description: Heals up to 15 points of the caster's own injuries, worst first.

AbilityDef.label: challenge
AbilityDef.description: The warden's capstone dare: enemies within 6.9 cells of the target point suffer -15% consciousness, -15% moving, and sharply reduced melee hit chance and shooting accuracy for 40 seconds.

AbilityDef.label: ambush
AbilityDef.description: A single perfect strike from close quarters: deals 300% of the caster's normal weapon damage to an adjacent target.

AbilityDef.label: shadowstep
AbilityDef.description: Teleports the caster to a visible cell within 19.9 cells.

AbilityDef.label: marked for death
AbilityDef.description: The rogue picks the one who dies first. The marked target takes +45% damage from all sources, but only for 40 seconds: a window to be used, not a debuff to leave running.

AbilityDef.label: vanish
AbilityDef.description: The caster becomes invisible for 15 seconds.

AbilityDef.label: magic missile
AbilityDef.description: A bolt of raw sigil-force. Deals 8 burn damage plus 2 per wizard level to a single target (30% armor penetration): 10 at wizard 1, 18 at wizard 5.

AbilityDef.label: arcane ward
AbilityDef.description: The warded target takes 50% less damage from all sources for 2 minutes.

AbilityDef.label: leaden curse
AbilityDef.description: The target moves at half speed and loses 20% manipulation for 45 seconds.

AbilityDef.label: blink
AbilityDef.description: Teleports the caster to a visible cell within 27.9 cells. The caster is briefly stunned on arrival.

AbilityDef.label: scorch
AbilityDef.description: Deals 14 burn damage to a single target with 30% armor penetration.

AbilityDef.label: arc lightning
AbilityDef.description: Deals 10 burn damage with 50% armor penetration to every enemy within 3.9 cells of the strike point. Allies are unharmed.

AbilityDef.label: firestorm
AbilityDef.description: Sets off an explosion at the target point: 20 flame damage in a 3.5-cell radius, igniting fires. Damages allies and enemies alike.

AbilityDef.label: rage
AbilityDef.description: For 60 seconds the caster deals +30% melee damage, feels half pain, and moves +0.3 faster, but shooting accuracy is greatly reduced.

AbilityDef.label: war cry
AbilityDef.description: Not a song. Enemies within 6.9 cells break stride and swing short: -20% moving and -15% melee damage for 40 seconds.

AbilityDef.label: unbreakable
AbilityDef.description: For 40 seconds the caster feels only 10% of pain and takes 25% less damage.

AbilityDef.label: whirlwind
AbilityDef.description: One full turning blow: strikes every enemy within melee range (1.9 cells) for the caster's normal weapon damage.

AbilityDef.label: nature's balm
AbilityDef.description: Heals up to 20 points of injury on the target, worst wounds first. Touch range.

AbilityDef.label: bramble snare
AbilityDef.description: Roots the target: 85% slower movement for 30 seconds.

AbilityDef.label: barkskin
AbilityDef.description: Sets one ally's skin like old oak: +40% sharp armor and +25% blunt armor for 2 minutes. One tree at a time, and all the stronger for it.

AbilityDef.label: summon bear
AbilityDef.description: Calls a grizzly bear out of the green dark to fight at the druid's side for 60 seconds. The bear attacks nearby enemies on its own and pads back to the druid when the field is quiet; when the magic fades it vanishes without a trace. Only one summoned bear can exist at a time.

AbilityDef.label: flurry
AbilityDef.description: For 40 seconds the caster's melee attacks come 40% faster and melee dodge chance rises by 10.

AbilityDef.label: inner calm
AbilityDef.description: The monk turns it inward. Purges disease, infection, poisoning and toxic buildup from the monk alone, and leaves them composed: +10% consciousness and a far steadier mind for 60 seconds. Recovers in a quarter of the time a cleric's cleanse takes.

AbilityDef.label: stunning palm
AbilityDef.description: Drops the touched target senseless with psychic shock. Does not work on animals.

AbilityDef.label: lay on hands
AbilityDef.description: Heals up to 35 points of injury on the target, worst wounds first. Touch range.

AbilityDef.label: righteous brand
AbilityDef.description: Names the wicked for what they are: the branded target's attacks falter, with sharply reduced melee hit chance and shooting accuracy for 60 seconds.

AbilityDef.label: aura of courage
AbilityDef.description: Allies within 9.9 cells gain -12% mental break threshold and +5% consciousness for 12 hours.

AbilityDef.label: charged shot
AbilityDef.description: Every draw measured, every loose meant: the caster's next 3 ranged attacks fly truer (improved accuracy) and deal 150% damage (charges last up to 60 seconds; a missed shot still spends its charge).

AbilityDef.label: field dressing
AbilityDef.description: Heals up to 15 points of injury on the target, worst wounds first. Touch range.

AbilityDef.label: hunter's mark
AbilityDef.description: The ranger settles on a quarry and does not lose it. The marked target takes +18% damage from all sources and moves 15% slower for a full four minutes. It is not a burst; it is a hunt.

AbilityDef.label: swift quiver
AbilityDef.description: For 60 seconds the caster's ranged attacks come 35% faster and shooting accuracy rises by 4.

AbilityDef.label: pass without trace
AbilityDef.description: The whole party moves like woodsmen for 10 minutes: enemies notice them at 40% less distance while sneaking. Stacks with darkness and light gear.\n\nDoes not itself hide anyone - the party must still be sneaking.
